steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then find the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health', open it, and report the exact titles of its panels as shown.

Create a NEW dashboard (not from a file/import) in Grafana titled exactly '{{runid}} {{01-open.breadcrumb_3}} Dashboard'. Add a Stat panel titled exactly '{{runid}} Availability' whose query uses the 'TestData' (grafana-testdata-datasource) data source. Also add a Text panel titled exactly '{{runid}} Notes' whose markdown content includes the text '{{runid}}' somewhere. Save the dashboard (fill the title, and give it the tag 'bench'). Confirm the save succeeded (not just Apply/Back) and report what happened.

recorded.save_confirmation: Dashboard saved alert shown; permanent URL /d/cfzaj95z4rh8ge/vgr3n-n1-bench-dashboard
recorded.panel_2_markdown: vgr3n-n1 Notes Bench notes for vgr3n-n1.

steps.instruction: On the dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.breadcrumb_3}} Dashboard' (uid {{02-create.url.p1}}), set the dashboard's time range to the last 6 hours (time picker -> Last 6 hours) and set the auto-refresh interval to 1 minute (time picker auto refresh -> 1m). Then open the Save dialog and TICK the 'Update default time range' checkbox before saving, so the 6h range is persisted into the saved dashboard. Save and confirm the save succeeded. Then report the dashboard's current browser page URL (copy it from the browser address bar / window.location, not from memory).

recorded.auto_refresh: 1m (refresh=1m; button reads 'Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected')
recorded.checkbox_ticked: Update default time range [checked] before Save

steps.instruction: Verification only: on dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.breadcrumb_3}} Dashboard' (uid {{02-create.url.p1}}), hard-reload/navigate fresh to http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard with NO time/refresh URL params, and report: (1) what the time picker shows after load (i.e. the dashboard's saved default range), (2) what the auto-refresh interval shows, (3) whether the tag 'bench' is listed, and (4) the titles of the panels. Do not change anything.

recorded.time_picker_after_fresh_load: Last 6 hours (button reads 'Time range selected: Last 6 hours'; URL gained ?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser from saved defaults; JSON model time = {from: now-6h, to: now})
recorded.auto_refresh_after_fresh_load: OFF — button reads 'Auto refresh turned off. Choose refresh time interval'; no refresh param in URL and saved JSON model contains NO "refresh" field, so the 1m default was NOT persisted
recorded.tag_bench_listed: yes — Settings > General shows tag 'bench' (Remove "bench" tag) and JSON model has "tags": ["bench"]
recorded.panel_titles: vgr3n-n1 Availability (stat, TestData) and vgr3n-n1 Notes (text)
recorded.changes_made: none — only navigation/reads; page left in view mode
recorded.auto_refresh_label: Auto refresh turned off. Choose refresh time interval

steps.instruction: On dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.breadcrumb_3}} Dashboard' (uid {{02-create.url.p1}}), persist the auto-refresh interval of 1m into the SAVED dashboard: go to Dashboard settings -> JSON Model, edit the JSON to set the top-level \"refresh\" field to the string \"1m\" (add it if absent; keep everything else unchanged), then click Save changes and confirm the save succeeded. Then hard-navigate to the bare URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard with no URL params and report what the auto-refresh button/picker shows after fresh load, and what the time picker shows.

recorded.auto_refresh_after_fresh_load: 1 minute — button aria-label: 'Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected', visible label '1m'
recorded.time_picker_after_fresh_load: Last 6 hours — button aria-label: 'Time range selected: Last 6 hours', visible label 'Last 6 hours'
recorded.save_confirmation: status alert 'Dashboard saved' after clicking 'Save changes' in Dashboard settings > JSON Model
recorded.json_edit: top-level "refresh": "1m" added (JSON validated by parsing: 129 lines; title/uid/tags/time/panels unchanged)
